paper.title: Phenotypic class ratios as marker signs of different types of agamospermy

result.summary: 本文以甜菜为例，开发了一种利用同工酶遗传标记对植物无融合生殖类型进行遗传分类的方法 [abstract]。该方法基于母本为杂合二倍体时，减数分裂无融合生殖与有丝分裂无融合生殖在后代中产生不同的表型类别比例 [abstract]。研究数据表明，甜菜中减数分裂无融合生殖更为典型，因为所研究的 15 个后代中有 13 个被归类为减数分裂无融合生殖产生，仅 2 个为有丝分裂无融合生殖产生 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 本文旨在开发一种以甜菜为例、对植物无融合生殖类型进行遗传分类的方法 [abstract]。其分类可行性依赖于使用同工酶作为遗传标记，从而能够识别单个杂合二倍体植株后代中的全部三种表型类别 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: This article focuses on the development of the method for the genetic classification of agamospermous reproduction types in plants using sugar beet as an example.
The classification feasibility is ensured by the use of isozymes as genetic markers allowing the identification of all three phenotypic classes in the progeny of individual heterozygous diploid plant

method.text: 该方法以同工酶作为遗传标记，识别单个杂合二倍体植株后代中的全部三种表型类别 [abstract]。分类依据是减数分裂无融合生殖与有丝分裂无融合生殖所获得的后代中表型类别比例不同 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: The classification feasibility is ensured by the use of isozymes as genetic markers allowing the identification of all three phenotypic classes in the progeny of individual heterozygous diploid plant
is based on different phenotypic class ratios in the progenies obtained by meiotic and mitotic agamospermy

experiments.text: 研究以甜菜为对象，对 15 个后代进行了分析 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: since 13 of 15 explored progenies were classified as those produced by meiotic agamospermy and only 2 as produced by mitotic agamospermy

findings.text: 数据表明，甜菜中减数分裂无融合生殖更为典型，因为所研究的 15 个后代中有 13 个被归类为减数分裂无融合生殖产生，仅 2 个为有丝分裂无融合生殖产生 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: The data indicate that for sugar beet meiotic agamospermy is the more typical since 13 of 15 explored progenies were classified as those produced by meiotic agamospermy and only 2 as produced by mitotic agamospermy.
